description: Flat metadata schema for bacterial single amplified genomes (SAGs) obtained from soil samples, including collection context, environmental conditions, whole-genome amplification, sequencing, and assembly details.

sample_id.descr: Unique record identifier for the individual soil SAG sample or genome record.

sample_name.descr: Human-readable sample name or field label used in notebooks/lab records.

collection_site_name.descr: Name of the sampling location/site (e.g., field name, reserve, forest plot).

collection_site_code.descr: Site code or shorthand identifier used by the project for the sampling location.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the collection site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the collection site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling site in meters above sea level.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

administrative_region.descr: State, province, county, or comparable administrative region of the sampling site.

habitat_type.descr: Broad habitat classification, for example forest soil, agricultural soil, grassland soil, tundra soil, or desert soil.

soil_classification.descr: Soil classification or taxonomy if available, such as USDA soil order or local soil type.

soil_horizon.descr: Soil horizon or depth layer sampled, for example O, A, B, or 0-10 cm.

sampling_depth_cm.descr: Depth of the soil sample collection in centimeters below surface.

collector.descr: Name or identifier of the person or team who collected the sample.

collection_method.descr: Description of the soil collection method, for example corer, sterile spatula, or auger.

sample_transport_condition.descr: Conditions used to transport or store the sample before DNA extraction, for example on ice, frozen, or at ambient temperature.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature of the sample prior to processing, in degrees Celsius.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content at collection or measurement time, expressed as percent.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at the time of collection, in degrees Celsius.

air_temperature_c.descr: Air temperature at the time of collection, in degrees Celsius.

pH.descr: Soil pH measured at or near the collection site.

organic_matter_percent.descr: Organic matter content of the soil, expressed as percent.

nitrogen_total_percent.descr: Total nitrogen content of the soil, expressed as percent.

carbon_total_percent.descr: Total carbon content of the soil, expressed as percent.

soil_texture.descr: Soil texture class, for example sand, loam, silt loam, clay loam.

salinity.descr: Soil salinity measurement or classification, if available.

vegetation_type.descr: Dominant vegetation cover associated with the sampling site.

land_use.descr: Land-use category, for example natural, agricultural, pasture, urban, or managed forest.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction protocol or kit used before whole-genome amplification.

wga_method.descr: Whole genome amplification approach used, for example MDA or WGA-X.

wga_kit_name.descr: Name of the whole-genome amplification kit used.

wga_kit_manufacturer.descr: Manufacturer or vendor of the amplification kit.

wga_input_dna_ng.descr: Amount of input DNA used for amplification, in nanograms.

wga_reaction_volume_ul.descr: Reaction volume used for whole genome amplification, in microliters.

wga_incubation_temperature_c.descr: Incubation temperature for the amplification reaction, in degrees Celsius.

wga_incubation_time_h.descr: Incubation time for the amplification reaction, in hours.

wga_replicate_number.descr: Replicate number if multiple amplification reactions were performed for the same sample.

wga_negative_control_used.descr: Whether a negative control was included in the whole-genome amplification workflow.

library_preparation_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used prior to sequencing.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used, for example Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, MiSeq, or Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_instrument_model.descr: Specific instrument model used for sequencing.

sequencing_read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for the sequencing run.

sequencing_layout.descr: Sequencing layout, for example single-end or paired-end.

sequencing_library_type.descr: Library type used for sequencing, for example shotgun metagenomic library.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Instrument run identifier or accession for the sequencing run.

sequencing_date.descr: Date on which sequencing was performed or run was initiated.

raw_reads_accession.descr: Accession or file identifier for the raw sequencing reads.

quality_filtering_software.descr: Software used for read quality control or trimming.

assembly_software.descr: Primary genome assembly software used to reconstruct the SAG genome.

assembly_algorithm.descr: Assembly algorithm or strategy used, for example de Bruijn graph, overlap-layout-consensus, or hybrid assembly.

assembly_version.descr: Version of the assembly software used.

assembly_parameters.descr: Key assembly parameters or command-line settings used, recorded as a string for reproducibility.

contig_count.descr: Number of contigs produced by the assembly.

assembly_total_length_bp.descr: Total assembled genome length in base pairs.

assembly_n50_bp.descr: N50 statistic of the assembled genome in base pairs.

assembly_gc_percent.descr: GC content of the assembled assembly, expressed as percent.

binning_method.descr: Binning approach used if genomes were grouped or refined beyond initial assembly.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness, expressed as percent.

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated genome contamination, expressed as percent.

taxonomy_assignment.descr: Taxonomic assignment of the SAG, ideally at the most resolved level available (for example genus or species).

marker_gene_profile.descr: Summary of marker genes or single-copy gene markers detected, if available.

functional_annotation_pipeline.descr: Software or pipeline used for functional annotation of the assembled genome.

key_nutrient_cycle_genes.descr: Notable genes or pathways relevant to nutrient cycling detected in the genome, recorded as a controlled string list if possible.

biosample_accession.descr: External biosample accession identifier, if deposited in a repository.

genome_accession.descr: Genome or assembly accession identifier, if deposited in a public database.

data_repository_url.descr: URL or persistent link to the associated data repository or record.

notes.descr: Free-text notes for unusual observations, protocol deviations, or site-specific context.
